description: gantry's readiness gate. On Stop and SubagentStop, if the repo has a .claude/gates.sh AND a task.md whose frontmatter says status: implementing, re-runs the gate out of band and blocks the stop (exit 2) when it is red. Inert otherwise — it exits 0 with no checks run and no perceptible delay. Set GANTRY_READINESS_GATE=off to disable entirely.
